purpose: Evaluate frozen M1D causal-topology global planning against original M-TARE under full-system stochasticity, with a complete-development-map oracle as a non-deployable upper-bound reference.

approval.scope: One immutable 90-case randomized-block run: tunnel and garage, environment seeds 11/23/37/53/71, 600 simulation seconds per case, original M-TARE three repeats, M1D checkpoint seeds 0/1/2 once each, and complete-map Oracle three repeats per block.
approval.confirmation_reference: After exact option A/B, 90-case counts, 17-20 hour estimate, 103-120 GB estimate and evidence plan were shown, the user replied '批准'.

trajectory_and_sampling.trajectory_definition: Each case is one complete closed-loop trajectory from the frozen world start; the exact 90 identities and randomized order are generated from the approved matrix and bound by schedule SHA-256.
trajectory_and_sampling.temporal_sampling: Retain every message on the frozen topic contract; coverage is integrated over the exact 600-second interval beginning at the first valid global waypoint.
trajectory_and_sampling.spatial_sampling: All finite map-frame registered-scan points are accumulated in fixed 0.5 m voxels; trajectory positions and global waypoints are retained without frame deletion.
trajectory_and_sampling.independence_statement: The ten world-by-environment-seed blocks are the paired analysis units. Three execution repeats and three M1D checkpoint seeds measure system/model variation and are not additional independent worlds.

methods.main: Frozen M1D range semantics -> causal trace-verified topometric graph -> deterministic frontier utility and Dijkstra -> /way_point -> unchanged M-TARE localPlanner/pathFollower.
methods.baseline: Original M-TARE global planner with the qualified explicit planner_seed patch, unchanged local planning and control.
methods.necessary_fallback_or_upper_bound: Layered complete-development-map topological oracle using the same causal graph, target handoff and local planner; explicitly non-deployable and never interpreted as a learned method.

model_and_teacher.checkpoint_selection: Frozen before Gate 6; exactly one execution per checkpoint in each world/seed block.
model_and_teacher.teacher: None for original M-TARE or M1D closed loop. The complete-map method is an explicit diagnostic upper bound, not labels or calibration data.

metrics_and_statistics.primary: 0.5 m unique-voxel coverage-time AUC over the fixed 600-second interval.
metrics_and_statistics.analysis: Average each family within each of the ten blocks, compare M1D minus original M-TARE with an exact two-sided sign-flip test and fixed 10,000-sample paired bootstrap CI, and Holm-correct the registered metric family.
metrics_and_statistics.effect_policy: Execution PASS means the frozen experiment completed faithfully. A positive, mixed or negative research effect is reported as observed and does not trigger reruns or method changes.

forbidden: case retry, deletion or result-driven reordering
claiming repeats or checkpoint seeds are independent worlds
leakage_and_failure_policy.stop: Any input/image/checkpoint drift, startup failure, missing or mistyped required topic, incomplete 600-second interval, non-finite metric, replacement-planner failed cycle, archive hash mismatch, disk floor breach or evidence failure seals the single formal run as FAIL and stops without retry.

evidence.per_case: Case contract, raw logs, losslessly verified zstd bag, topic audit, trajectory, coverage curve, waypoints, metrics, exit state, and for replacement methods the graph snapshot and decision trace.
evidence.aggregate: Exact case schedule, matrix audit, family/block statistics, effect sizes, confidence intervals, p-values, stability metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.expected_pass_counts: 90/90 cases, 10/10 complete blocks, 30 cases per family, 54,000 total simulated seconds, zero C09/C10/training/optimizer activity.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU/Gazebo/ROS execution, no GPU; zstd level 10 after every case; minimum 150 GiB free-space gate before every case.
